direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px header / 44px guide / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; at 1366x768 use 184px step rail / minmax(0,1fr) stage / 360px inspector; stage minimum 55vw x 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; refit tight panels before reducing type; all targets at least 36px
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68); primary neon #A8F04A with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge any stage label under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; vertical step rail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets, replacing the clipped horizontal scroller; guide strip with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory stage SVG; inspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside the stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Preserve the required header and opening-story logo placements at native aspect; remove any additional logo-like mark from the stage header to keep exactly two placements.
Enlarge factory node labels and legend text to 11px minimum and give SVG nodes keyboard focus with a 2px neon focus ring.
Align Certificate 120 and Receiving 80 tracks to one scale with DOES NOT MATCH contained fully inside the stage bounds.
Separate ROUTE HEALTH PRE-FLIGHT (nonce, identity) from INVESTIGATION SOURCE EVIDENCE with distinct headings, borders, status text and controls so the two tasks cannot be conflated.
Shorten the inspector copy to one instruction and one status sentence; move offline-sample detail behind a disclosure to restore viewport fit.
Make Run Sample investigation the sole primary and ensure its label, enabled state and focus ring remain visible without scrolling at 1366x768.
Keep selecting a recovery option as the action that opens the typed consent form; label the primary Review recovery option and announce the selection via aria-live.
Add selected-state pattern plus text to the three comparison rows so choice is not carried by outline alone.
Trim empty lower inspector space by enlarging tradeoff metrics and aligning finish and incremental values on one baseline.
Label the proposal clearly as deliberately untracked until human approval in both stage and inspector, with Approve and Decline kept as separate 40px controls.
Replace terse t1/t2/t3 stage chips with full task titles or add expandable detail so the stage matches the inspector task list.
Reduce duplicated proposal text; show task count, owner and due offset once, then list the three tasks in an internally scrolling region.
Keep CELL-MILL-2 preview visually distinct from applied stopped state using dashed silver preview until Apply, then switch to the reserved red stopped treatment.
Enlarge the 24h to 0h capacity change and tie it to CELL-MILL-1 and CELL-MILL-2 nodes with bidirectional highlighting.
State in the action bar that applying invalidates the named accepted plan, retaining one primary Apply second shock control.
Preserve red exclusively on stopped CELL-MILL-2: red outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text, with no route drawn through that cell.
Again keep pre-flight nonce/identity checks separate from the investigation evidence task, and update feasible paths to 3 to 2 in both stage and inspector.
Mark Split available capacity as constrained in the stage cards with pattern and reason text, not colour alone.
Disable selection for the constrained Split option with an explanatory note, while keeping its row focusable for keyboard and screen-reader access.
Keep the red stopped CELL-MILL-2 treatment consistent with step 6 and remove any dashed feasible route ending at that cell.
Make Prior acceptance invalidated the single status sentence in the action bar and keep Review revised option as sole primary, opening the typed consent form on selection.
Keep 3 blocked prior tasks visibly separate from 3 proposed replacements awaiting approval, stating that the approved revised plan and blocked prior tasks coexist.
Use full blocked task titles in the stage as well as the inspector, avoiding reliance on t1/t2/t3 chips alone.
Shorten the truncated action-bar status to Approved revised plan - replacements await approval at 11px minimum.
Sequence Verify ledger, Seal packet and Retain checkpoint as numbered locked steps, disabling later controls until prerequisites complete and announcing progress via aria-live.
Enlarge passphrase guidance and error text to 12px minimum and keep the field plus its requirement visible without inspector scroll at 1366x768.
Show 70 parts, 35h accepted plan and 48h comparison with one label each, avoiding repetition between stage cards and inspector metrics.
Add check marker plus SEALED text on all three completion cards so completion is not carried by green fill alone.
Keep Packet sealed summary to one line naming 18 events, revised plan accepted and CELL-MILL-2 offline retained.
Ensure Complete in the step rail uses aria-current and that Back remains the only secondary control, with no new primary introduced.
